d:
Pauranik katha sanpurn ramayan (1961) ke pavan prasangon ka aanand len, jahan prabhu shri ram, mata sita aur lakshman ki dharm aur saty ki gatha jivant hoti hai. altra muvi parlar par abhi laiv dekhen! abhi dekhen aur bhaktimay klasik philmon ke lie chainal ko sabsakraib karen!
Movie : Sampoorna Ramayan (1961)
Cast: Mahipal, Anita Guha, Sulochana Latkar, Lalita Pawar, Helen, Achala Sachdev, B.M. Vyas, Manhar Desai, Raj Kumar
Director: Babubhai Mistry
Producer: Homi Wadia
Music Director: Vasant Desai
Lyricist: Bharat Vyas
Story: Valmiki, Narottam Vyas Madhur
